fields.name: userId
fields.description: Recipient (filter target). The userId that hid the announcement — the read path filters by `filter: { userId: <me> }` so each user only sees their own hide rows. Same pattern as Notification / MemberProject.

fields.name: announcementId
fields.description: ItemId of the Announcement the user dismissed. Replaces localStorage key 'hiddenAnnouncements:v1:<userId>'. Echoed on every PATCH (requiredOn: 'Both').

fields.name: hiddenAt
fields.description: ISO timestamp stamped when the user hid the announcement. Audit only; not surfaced in the UI.
